_note: SYNTHETIC envelopes reproducing the EXACT wire shape the Binance Web3 API returns, for DEC-030. The structure (msg / code / data / success / timestamp) and the numeric type of `code` were observed live on probe_run 1f42f52f-a9c8-463d-8bf9-a344758f3b6c (2026-09-30, chain 56); jsonb_typeof(response_json->'code') is 'number' for every recorded call. Timestamps are invented and the auth/transient entries are constructed rather than captured (this project has never deliberately triggered an auth failure), hence SYNTHETIC_ rather than DOC_EXAMPLE_. No secrets, wallet addresses, or order ids - envelope scaffolding only. Never imported from src.
_whyItMatters: `code` arrives as a JSON number while the docs present the codes as strings. Every existing client test used string codes, so the retry decision was never exercised against the real shape: NO_RETRY_CODES silently never matched and auth failures were retried maxRetries times.
